messages.author: f0383747efe2ff95
messages.subject: Convergence issue with multi-norm sampler
parts:
Hi Nimble community,
When I run the following code, I hit the issue that the sampled MCMC outputs are unrealistic constrained than the covariance that I set (e.g., pf[8, 8] ~ 107 while the sampled variance is just 0.0007). Does anyone know the reason? I also attached the Rdata file to this email.
I really appreciate any help you can provide.

Best,
Dongchen

Here is the code:
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
GEF.MultiSite.Nimble <-  nimbleCode({
  X.mod[1:N] ~ dmnorm(mean = muf[1:N], cov = pf[1:N, 1:N])
  for (i in 1:YN) {
      #sample Q.
      q[i] ~ dgamma(shape = aq[i], rate = bq[i])
      if (length(H) == 1) {
        X[i]  ~ dnorm(X.mod[H], sd = 1/sqrt(q[i]))
        #likelihood
        y.censored[i] ~ dnorm(X[i], sd = 1/sqrt(r[i]))
      } else {
        #sample latent variable X.
        # X[i]  ~ dnorm(X.mod[H[i]], sd = 1/sqrt(q[i]))
        X[i] <- X.mod[H[i]]
        #likelihood
        y.censored[i] ~ dnorm(X[i], sd = 1/sqrt(r[i, i]))
      }
  }
})
model_pred <- nimble::nimbleModel(GEF.MultiSite.Nimble,
                                  data = block$data,
                                  inits = block$Inits,
                                  constants = block$constant,
                                  name = 'base')
#configure MCMC
conf <- nimble::configureMCMC(model_pred, print=FALSE)
conf$setMonitors(c("X", "X.mod", "q"))
#compile MCMC
Rmcmc <- nimble::buildMCMC(conf)
Cmodel <- nimble::compileNimble(model_pred)
Cmcmc <- nimble::compileNimble(Rmcmc, project = model_pred, showCompilerOutput = FALSE)
#run MCMC
dat <- runMCMC(Cmcmc, niter = block$MCMC$niter, nburnin = block$MCMC$nburnin, thin = block$MCMC$nthin, nchains = block$MCMC$nchain)
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

messages.author: f0383747efe2ff95
messages.subject: Re: Convergence issue with multi-norm sampler
parts:
Hi,
The problem has been solved by inferring the initial values of the covariance matrix through the propCov argument when refactoring the sampler.

Best,
Dongchen
